title: Write the note that future you will actually understand
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: State the question — Explain why the material matters.; Keep evidence separate — Distinguish observation, source, and interpretation.; Leave a restart point — Name the next action and its prerequisites.; Read it later — Repair missing context and retire obsolete material..
